verdict.rationale: Adyen documents 'payment links' as a hosted, no-UI checkout option (adyen-docs-24), and general checkout docs mention styling/localization (adyen-docs-15/19), but the evidence pack lacks detail on conversion optimization or hosted-page specifics, and community feedback repeatedly flags Adyen's integration as more complex/'bare metal' compared to turnkey competitors (adyen-comm-5, adyen-comm-9).
